Introduction

This document lists the 
 minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
performed from eight to twelve 8-12 years in service to determine the max. wear of the main 
contacts of the breaker poles, therfore, we can decide if the equipment has to 
be reconditioned or not as indicated by Y8:12 in the title block.

The first draft 
was initiated and tested by eng. Naser El Sayed Abd EL-Aziz,, accepted by general director eng. 
Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director and MPIS Coordinator..
Safety Precautions

De-energize and ground the circuit 
 breaker

Interrupt the control circuit of 
 the motor

Discharge the closing and opening 
 springs by operating the manual levers in the operating mechanism until no 
 more operations (on-off) are possible

Interrupt the control circuit of 
 the close and trip coils

The circuit breaker should be out 
 of service

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ...etc

Contact resistance measuring device

Depth gauge,
 Ampero-meter
Slow motion device
Work to be Carried Out

Now the circuit breaker is 
"open" the springs are discharged and the control circuits of the motor and 
coils are interrupted as mentioned above

Close the circuit breaker 
by the slow motion device(fig2)

Connect the tester to high 
voltage terminals (fig 1)

Move the circuit breaker 
towards "off" by the slow motion until the instance of stopping the "beep" of 
the tester and measure the distance "Xa" the distance Xis measured from outside 
edge of chassis to left end of linkage "viewed from motor wound spring operating 
mechanism (fig 1)

Repeat the same procedures 
of poles b,c to measure Xb, Xc

Definitions: 
Xa,Xb,Xc = the distances in service status, 
 Xa0,Xb0,Xc0 = the distances in new status

Calculate the value X-X0 
for the three poles
This value (X-X0) must equal or less than 6 mm and if not the breaker must be 
reconditioned

The state of 
the contact material respectively the wear caused by arcing can be checked from 
the outside. Thus unnecessary opening of the circuit breaker respectively of the 
gas compartments can be avoided before the date of recondtioning

To determine 
the maximum admissible wear proceed as described below
Figure 1

Dimension X at 
the moment of electrical contact separation has been determined for poles a,b 
and c of each circuit breaker on completion of erection and recorded on the 
label in motor wound spring operating mechanism 70.00 (see chapter "Final 
inspections")

During service 
period xa , xb and xc can be checked from time to time. If dimension x at one or 
more poles differa from its new-condition value by 6 mm or more the equipment 
will have to be reconditioned
